# apple_end_user_license_agreement (Resource)

Sets a custom license agreement for an app in the listed territories, replacing Apple's standard agreement there. An app has at most one. Import it by app ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_end_user_license_agreement" "example" {
  app_id         = data.apple_app.example.id
  agreement_text = file("${path.module}/license.txt")
  territory_ids  = ["USA", "CAN", "GBR"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agreement_text` (String) Text of the license agreement.
- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `territory_ids` (Set of String) Territories where the agreement applies, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes, e.g. `USA`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the agreement.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_end_user_license_agreement.example
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_end_user_license_agreement.example 1234567890
```
